name: Electronics Engineering Technology
description: Electronics engineering technology programmes train the people who build, test and keep electronic systems working — circuits, instrumentation, microcontrollers, programmable controllers and the equipment they sit in. ⚠ It is the applied half of electrical engineering: an associate degree, not a four-year one, and aimed at the bench rather than the design office.
degreesNote: This is an associate degree programme (A.S. or A.A.S.), usually two years, and at several Florida colleges it continues into a bachelor's in engineering technology — which is the reason to check articulation before you enrol. ⚠⚠ Do not confuse it with electrical ENGINEERING: the technology degree is accredited by ABET's ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY commission, and under Florida law it carries a SIX-year experience requirement for a PE licence against four for an engineering degree. That matters only if licensure is your goal — most electronics technicians never licence — but it is not reversible late.

cips.note: Electrical and electronic engineering technologies — 20 Florida public institutions, with 15.0303 (electrical/electronics technology) the main code at 19 of them and 264 credentials in 2023.

related.note: The umbrella series this sits in — 76 institutions across every engineering technology field, and the place to look if you want the family rather than this branch.

⚠ The four-year degree beside it, and the distinction that matters: engineering designs, technology builds and maintains. The engineering degree keeps the PE route open on the shorter timetable; this one is faster, cheaper and closer to the equipment.
Where these skills go inside a plant — controls, instrumentation and automation. The clock-hour route to much of the same work.
